description: Reads a pasted army list into a roster draft without saving it or needing an account, as the site's import does. Takes the whole text export from the official Warhammer 40,000 app, New Recruit, BattleBase, ListForge, Warscribe, WTC layouts or Praetorium, or a Praetorium exchange code (PR1./PR2.). draft is the list in the shape check_roster and save_roster take, or null when no faction matched. review is what the importing player sees: matchedEntries of sourceEntries, the points the text reported against currentPoints at the selected rules version, notImported (units, detachments or lines left out, each with why) and builtByDatasheet (units that imported but keep their datasheet defaults for the choices named, each with why). Tell the player about every row in both before relying on the draft. When battleSizeStated is false the draft uses 2000 points; ask the player. Anything the import had to assume, such as a unit's god, is named in builtByDatasheet; nothing is substituted silently.

file.description: The complete export text, or an exchange code.

name: import_roster
title: Import an army list
